dimensions.note: apiKey is sensitive, optional and non-empty; sent only as a Bearer header on GET; redirects refused; absent from logs and errors. The vault path itself has not been run; the keyed run used an env expression, and C1 covers the vault path.
Info on entry and completion with structured placeholders, warning when incomplete, no secrets.

Low, open by scope. R4-F5: HTTP failures carry only the status. R4-F7: docs say number null means a list page failed, but it also covers a moved list and an invalid row. Input errors and a run that read nothing throw before writing.

Low. R5-F1: mutating 'total ?? previousTotal' to 'total' survives all 47 tests. The R4-F1 test fails against first-total comparison, and each R4-F2 test kills its mutant. The hand-built context instead of createModelTestContext is disclosed.
Read-only. An incomplete since read holds its cursor, a complete one overlaps by five minutes, and a run that read nothing leaves the last record as latest.

Low, open by scope. R4-F3: paging ends on a short page without consulting total. R4-F4: a row with no updatedAt passes the since test. Both latent on production. Falling totals are now compared page to page; 429 and 503 retry with Retry-After.
Unused response bodies are cancelled, each attempt has its own timeout, the sleep clears its timer and listener, and body requests are bounded at six.
Only public swamp-club.com URLs and placeholder fixtures; no IP addresses or internal hosts; .reviews is not in the published files.
Plain z.object schemas, no passthrough. Mechanical checks pass: the one writeResource writes every DigestSchema field, with truncated set from both caps and no placeholders.
digest has infinite lifetime and keeps 10 versions; the README says records keep what the key can read for those versions.
A read-only digest, not a CRUD lifecycle.

Low, open by scope. R4-F6: numbers with since writes named issues into changes, so the jq form labels them changed. The instances do not collide: one write per run, same schema, and narrowed reads cannot replace the cursor.
Reads no stored state; the cursor is passed as input.
